understand.uses.instructions: Is a {platform} tool ({purpose}) needed as an instrument to carry out `request`?

criteria.true: The task cannot be done without using this kind of tool.
criteria.false: The tool is not needed, is only mentioned, or is the thing being looked for.

understand.mail_role.instructions: What role does email play in `request`?

criteria.operate_mailbox: Send, read, search, draft or manage messages inside a connected mailbox.
criteria.find_address: An email address is information to find, look up or verify, for example on the web.
criteria.no_mail: The request is not about email at all.

criteria: A single lookup or question answered with one tool
A few reads combined into one answer
Several steps, some of which change something
Building or changing a reusable workflow

understand.side_effects.instructions: Would carrying out `request` send, create, update, delete, publish, schedule or charge anything outside J/OS HQ?

criteria.true: At least one outward-facing change is needed.
criteria.false: Only reading, searching or answering is needed.

trim.connection.instructions: Could the tool named "{name}" in `tools` be useful for `request`?

criteria.true: It might be used, even partly.
criteria.false: It is clearly irrelevant to this request.

repeat.same_as.instructions: Is `request` the same task as `candidates[{i}].asked`, so that the same plan would accomplish it?

criteria.true: The same task; only the wording differs.
criteria.false: A different task, target, recipient or scope.
